newsitem.title: USA: Unit well flows natgas after fracing.
newsitem.headline: Unit well flows natgas after fracing.

text.p: Unit Corp said Wednesday the McBee 1 well, located in Canadian County, Oklahoma, has flowed natural gas after fracture treatment from 18 feet of pay in two Springer sand intervals from 11,993 feet to 12,022 feet.
The well is selling 4,056,000 cubic feet of natural gas per day, the company said. Unit has a 99.84 percent working interest in a 640-acre drilling unit in the prospect.
It said the well also contains three additional potential productive formations that will be tested at a later date.
Plans are to immediately start an offset well, the Powers 2, at a location one-half mile east of the McBee 1. Unit will participate in the well with a 24.2 percent working interest.
